Ikuta Shrine

activities_top.name: Mount Rokko (Rokko Cable & Rokko Garden Terrace)
activities_top.hours: Rokko Cable ~7:10-21:10 (every 20 min); Rokko Garden Terrace shops mostly 9:30-20:00 (varies by shop)

activities_top.name: Nankinmachi (Kobe Chinatown)
activities_top.hours: Street always open; shops and stalls roughly 11:00-21:00, varying by shop

activities_top.name: Kobe Nunobiki Herb Gardens & Ropeway
activities_top.hours: Ropeway uphill basically 9:30-16:45; until 20:15 on many weekends/holidays, in summer and in the Christmas season (2026: 7 Nov–6 Dec Fri–Sun & holidays, 11–25 Dec daily); garden hours vary by season

closed.irregular: Ropeway and gardens closed for inspection 2027-01-23 to 2027-02-12 (also 2026-08-31 to 09-03); suspended in strong wind or thunder

activities_top.name: Kobe Port Tower
activities_top.hours: Observation floor (5F) and rooftop deck 9:00-23:00 (2026 listings); other floors vary

events.name: Kobe Luminarie
events.recurrence: yearly, late January–early February (10 days in 2027)

editions.note: 32nd edition; Meriken Park (partly paid area), Higashi Yuenchi and the former foreign settlement; lit from dusk to about 21:30 (based on previous edition)

events.name: Kobe Matsuri
events.recurrence: yearly, main festival on a Sunday in mid-May (3rd Sunday in 2026 and 2027)

editions.note: 54th edition (planned); parade and main festival around Higashi Yuenchi and the former foreign settlement
